svg.text: Native RLL · 42 source / 42 displayed rungs · full · Programs/MainProgram/Routines/WH_ReceiveLinks · b2abab6526432e22616c
ADDED · Changing CDL while handling a part is rejected; selection is an idle operation.
ADDED · Select one CDL adapter and establish a fresh baseline. No cross-CDL event replay.
ADDED · Set the source-age TIMER preset explicitly.
ADDED · CDL 1: freeze the existing ctrl_CDL_DC appended member.
ADDED · CDL 2: normalize its separate existing ctrl_CDL2_DC mailbox.
ADDED · Freshness advances only when a new source snapshot arrives.
ADDED · Three-second source age limit; no repeated-packet freshness refresh.
ADDED · Sender restarted after binding: expose the changed epoch instead of replaying it.
ADDED · Initial connection establishes an event baseline. Start observing before a part transfer.
ADDED · Accept only a current, clock-validated, fault-free source.
ADDED · Expected next event count is bounded.
ADDED · Skipped/regressed source event count is a visible capture fault.
ADDED · One local edge for each new source event, independent of MSG retry count.
ADDED · Consume the transport identity once; source payload remains available.
ADDED · Receive the unchanged two-DINT legacy status transfer; freshness follows the existing heartbeat bit.
ADDED · Observe BOTH transitions of the existing press status handshake, not a static good-quality bit.
ADDED · New received heartbeat advances link freshness.
ADDED · Communication loss is data quality, not a timed Cycle Start.
ADDED · Require a new heartbeat and counter baseline after communication loss; do not replay delayed events.
ADDED · Establish the current counter as baseline on initial connection/reconnection, without publishing an event.
ADDED · Press validity needs no source clock or added heartbeat packet.
ADDED · A skipped or reset counter is not a Cycle Start; expose the discontinuity for re-baselining.
ADDED · Consume a persistent counter change once.
ADDED · FDC arrival timestamp: advisory +/-1 s under normal communications; not a source timestamp.
ADDED · Receive the unchanged two-DINT legacy status transfer; freshness follows the existing heartbeat bit.
ADDED · Observe BOTH transitions of the existing press status handshake, not a static good-quality bit.
ADDED · New received heartbeat advances link freshness.

ADDED · Require a new heartbeat and counter baseline after communication loss; do not replay delayed events.

ADDED · Press validity needs no source clock or added heartbeat packet.
ADDED · A skipped or reset counter is not a Cycle Start; expose the discontinuity for re-baselining.
ADDED · Consume a persistent counter change once.

SOURCE · original PLC storage / Item InOut
Blue = original. Red = fault + nonzero code; fault 0 = neutral. Yellow = state + value. GUTTER = group / qualifier; INIT is a label only.
